mapper.update: UPDATE `report` SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, r.reporter_id AS reporterId, COALESCE(u.username, CONCAT('用户#', r.reporter_id)) AS reporterName, r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.reason, r.status, r.handler_id AS handlerId, r.handle_result AS handleResult, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, CASE WHEN r.target_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(p.title, CONCAT('帖子#', r.target_id)) WHEN r.target_type = 2 THEN COALESCE(c.content, CONCAT('评论#', r.target_id)) ELSE CONCAT('目标#', r.target_id) END AS targetSummary FROM `report` r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN `post` p ON r.target_type = 1 AND p.id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN `comment` c ON r.target_type = 2 AND c.id = r.target_id

where.if: AND ( r.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `report` r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.reporter_id LEFT JOIN `post` p ON r.target_type = 1 AND p.id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN `comment` c ON r.target_type = 2 AND c.id = r.target_id
